        ### Question

        ### Options

opb. The higher the consumption of fiber, the lower the water intake.

opd. Legumes are a poor source of fiber.
ope. In the adult, 10-15 g of fiber are recommended daily.

CHAIN: "Refined seeds" -> "removal of bran and germ" -> "lower fiber content" -> "not high fiber" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Legumes" -> "contain both soluble and insoluble fiber" -> "good source of fiber" -> "not poor source" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Adults" -> "recommended fiber intake" -> "25-30 g daily" -> "10-15 g insufficient" -> 85%
